title: Design Zoom Video Conferencing
description: Model meetings, participants, screen sharing, and recording.

data.text: Design a video conferencing system like Zoom. Users schedule meetings, join as participants, share screens, and record sessions.

data.title: Meeting and Participant
Recording vs Streaming
data.text: Recording stores full media locally or in cloud storage. Streaming broadcasts live with lower latency. Recording is easier to model: just append bytes to a file keyed by MeetingId.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Meeting is a live session with a host
Participant tracks role, mute, and screen-share state
Recording is a Meeting flag plus a background writer
Screen sharing is just another media stream with higher priority
data.takeaway: Zoom is a meeting with participants and media streams. Participants are stateful. Recording is an append-only stream.
